title: img2threejs
brief: A skill for coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode) that rebuilds the object in a reference photo as a code-only, procedural Three.js model — reconstruction-by-code, not photogrammetry or mesh extraction — with a staged sculpting pipeline (blockout → material → lighting → optimization) and vision-review quality gates. It is deliberately token-efficient: deterministic scripts handle validation while model tokens are spent only on visual judgment and code; Apache 2.0, around 16.7k stars, with a live demo gallery.
details: img2threejs (Apache 2.0) rebuilds the object in a reference image as a code-only, procedural, quality-gated, animation-ready Three.js model — reconstruction by code, not photogrammetry or mesh extraction, and deliberately token-efficient. It runs as an agent skill under Claude Code, Codex, or OpenCode: give it one image and it classifies the subject, enumerates a detail inventory of identity-defining small details, then generates a TypeScript THREE.Group factory pass by pass (blockout, structural, form, material, surface, lighting, interaction, optimization), vision-reviewing each pass against the reference until quality gates clear, with a runtime hierarchy of pivots, sockets, and colliders so results are ready to animate. Deterministic Python scripts handle validation and gating while model tokens are spent only on visual judgment; a resumable local workflow (forge/state.py) supports multi-session builds, and domain plugins add specialized tracks (CS2 weapon skins, rigged characters). A live demo gallery shows the generated models running in the browser with inspectable source. Around seventeen thousand GitHub stars.
